files.name: dochi_minigames-0.1.0-fabric-1.21.1.jar
files.html:
Dochi`s Minigames 0.1.0

  • Seven games: Monty Hall, Slots, Memory, Whack-a-Mole, Timing Challenge, High Low, and Shooting Gallery.
  • 40 built-in presets with adjustable difficulty, visuals, entry fees, and rewards.
  • In-game editing, NPC assignment, and Go Minigames dialogue integration.
  • Minecraft sounds, particles, and animations.
  • Optional Cobblemon rewards and CobbleDollars entry fees.
